    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.Reflection.DimensionVector, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    Simple reflections on the dimension vectors of a quiver #

    For a vertex i of a finite quiver Q, the simple reflection sᵢ is the reflection of the dimension-vector lattice Q → ℤ that negates the simple dimension vector αᵢ = Pi.single i 1 and fixes the hyperplane orthogonal to it for the polarized Tits form. It is the numerical shadow of the Bernstein-Gelfand-Ponomarev reflection functor at i, and the generator of the Weyl group action under which the roots of the Tits form are stable.

    The reflection is built from Mathlib's Module.preReflection, taking the linear form to be the polarized Tits form paired with αᵢ. Following that naming, LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexPreReflection is available with no hypothesis on i, while the reflection identities need q(αᵢ) = 1, equivalently that i carries no loop; LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexReflection is the automorphism obtained at such a loopless vertex. In an acyclic quiver every vertex is loopless, by LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.IsAcyclic.isEmpty_hom_self.

    The reflection of the quiver itself, which reverses the arrows at i, is LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.Reflect in LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.Reflection.Basic; LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.Reflection.EulerForm relates the two.

    Main definitions and results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexPreReflection: the map sᵢ, as a ℤ-linear endomorphism of the dimension-vector lattice, defined at every vertex.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexReflection: the same map at a loopless vertex, where it is a genuine reflection, packaged as a linear automorphism.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.titsForm_vertexPreReflection: the simple reflection at a loopless vertex preserves the Tits form; LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.titsPolarForm_vertexPreReflection is the bilinear counterpart.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.bijOn_vertexPreReflection: consequently the simple reflection permutes each level set of the Tits form, in particular the roots q(d) = 1.

    References #

    See Derksen--Weyman, An Introduction to Quiver Representations.

    noncomputable def LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexPreReflection (Q : Type u) [Quiver Q] [Fintype Q] [(a b : Q) → Fintype (a ⟶ b)] [DecidableEq Q] (i : Q) :
    Module.End ℤ (Q → ℤ)

    The simple reflection sᵢ at a vertex i, acting on dimension vectors by d ↦ d - ⟨αᵢ, d⟩ αᵢ for the polarized Tits form and the simple dimension vector αᵢ = Pi.single i 1.

    No hypothesis on i is imposed here, following Module.preReflection; the reflection identities hold at a loopless vertex, where ⟨αᵢ, αᵢ⟩ = 2, and there vertexReflection packages this map as an automorphism.

      theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexPreReflection_apply_self_of_isEmpty (Q : Type u) [Quiver Q] [Fintype Q] [(a b : Q) → Fintype (a ⟶ b)] [DecidableEq Q] {i : Q} (h : IsEmpty (i ⟶ i)) (d : Q → ℤ) :
      (vertexPreReflection Q i) d i = -d i + ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (↑(Fintype.card (i ⟶ v)) + ↑(Fintype.card (v ⟶ i))) * d v

      At a loopless vertex the reflected coordinate is the classical formula -dᵢ + ∑_{v ≠ i} (#(i ⟶ v) + #(v ⟶ i)) d_v, the sum running over the neighbours of i.

      theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.vertexPreReflection_single_of_ne (Q : Type u) [Quiver Q] [Fintype Q] [(a b : Q) → Fintype (a ⟶ b)] [DecidableEq Q] (i : Q) {j : Q} (hj : j ≠ i) :
      (vertexPreReflection Q i) (Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single j 1 + (↑(Fintype.card (i ⟶ j)) + ↑(Fintype.card (j ⟶ i))) • Pi.single i 1

      The simple reflection at i adds a multiple of αᵢ to any other simple dimension vector, the multiple being the number of arrows joining the two vertices in either direction.
